reasons: The Agreement is a site development/hosting arrangement in which HDI (vendor) holds the Company's Content and customer data, and the cited termination provisions (4.1 notice/Termination Date and 4.2(c) Termination Payment mechanics) contain no exit, transition, data return/export or deletion language — a genuine 'missing' classification under TRANSITION.

The inserted Section 4.3 tracks the preferred position and model language closely (up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return in a commonly used machine-readable format, subsequent deletion with written certification) and is correctly directed at HDI as the hosting party, benefiting us as Customer.

Placement after the Termination Payment mechanics in Section 4 is sensible, numbering is consistent, and the added protection against premature deletion/withholding directly addresses the playbook walk-away scenario (immediate deletion of Customer Data) without materially expanding scope.
Comment is concise, in first person plural, explains the change and cites the 90-day fallback as offered; deterministic checks confirm the transition/data-return language is present.
